items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: He's the one that taught me how to transpose; that's the first thing he taught me.

ctx.x: So he went away and as I said, he brought me this saxophone back and there was a fella there that played saxophone and trumpet by the name of Emmett Malone, He was a very advanced musician. He just had talent because he was way ahead of time, really. It's too bad he didn't pursue

it because he just went out and he passed about four or five years ago as a -- he was a streetcar driver out in San Francisco, but a fine musician. So he got me started, along with a white fellow by the name of Frank O'Bannon. He's the one that taught me how to transpose; that's the first thing he taught me. So I thought he was crazy when he was telling me to take a G and make a B out of it, you know.
